steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Engineering geology applies geological knowledge to civil engineering: site investigation, rock properties, and hazard assessment

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Site investigation: desk study, walkover survey, boreholes, trial pits, geophysical surveys, and laboratory testing

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Key rock properties: strength, permeability, porosity, discontinuities (joints, faults), and weathering grade

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Foundation design depends on bearing capacity: strong bedrock supports heavy structures; weak clay requires deep foundations
